description: Hosting of Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting (CLMM) - 2019
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2019-07-30
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval previously, to hold the Commonwealth Law Ministers' Meeting in Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms to organize and hold the said meeting under the theme 'Equal Access to Justice and the Rule of Law', was approved by the Cabinet.
